# Supported agents

<!-- Generated by scripts/agent-surfaces.ts from src/integrations/registry.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tracetoon works with 16 coding agents. For a ✅ agent it reads the
session logs the agent keeps on your machine, a PR hook sends the agent's PR
commands (`gh pr create` and the like) to Tracetoon, and the skill is
installed where the agent looks for skills. A 🟡 agent is missing part of
that; the notes below say what.

| Agent         | Covers                                        | Support                 | PR hook                                        | Skill folder                        |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Claude Code   | CLI, IDE extensions and desktop app           | ✅ supported             | `~/.claude/settings.json`                      | `~/.claude/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Codex         | CLI and app                                   | ✅ supported             | `~/.codex/hooks.json`                          | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Antigravity   | CLI and IDE                                   | ✅ supported             | `~/.gemini/config/hooks.json`                  | `~/.gemini/config/skills/tracetoon` |
| Factory Droid | Droid CLI                                     | ✅ supported             | `~/.factory/hooks.json`                        | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Copilot       | CLI and VS Code agent mode                    | ✅ supported             | `~/.copilot/hooks/tracetoon.json`              | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Cursor        | IDE and CLI                                   | ✅ supported (see notes) | `~/.cursor/hooks.json`                         | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| OpenCode      | CLI                                           | ✅ supported             | `~/.config/opencode/plugins/tracetoon.js`      | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Kilo CLI      | CLI, and Kilo Code for VS Code, which runs it | ✅ supported             | `~/.config/kilo/plugins/tracetoon.js`          | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Kiro          | IDE and CLI                                   | ✅ supported             | `~/.kiro/hooks/tracetoon.json`                 | `~/.kiro/skills/tracetoon`          |
| Cline         | CLI                                           | ✅ supported (see notes) | `~/.cline/hooks/PreToolUse.mjs`                | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Junie         | JetBrains CLI                                 | ✅ supported             | `~/.junie/config.json`                         | `~/.junie/skills/tracetoon`         |
| Devin         | CLI                                           | ✅ supported             | Claude Code's hook, which Devin imports        | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Goose         | CLI and desktop app                           | ✅ supported             | `~/.agents/plugins/tracetoon/hooks/hooks.json` | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Qwen Code     | CLI                                           | ✅ supported             | `~/.qwen/settings.json`                        | `~/.qwen/skills/tracetoon`          |
| Crush         | CLI                                           | ✅ supported             | `~/.config/crush/crush.json`                   | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Amp           | CLI                                           | 🟡 partial (see notes)  | `~/.config/amp/plugins/tracetoon.ts`           | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Windsurf      |                                               | 🗓️ planned             |                                                |                                     |

## Notes

- **Cursor:** Cursor's logs don't record exit codes, so the PR can't confirm that tests or builds passed.
- **Cline:** PRs opened through GitHub connector or MCP tools are not redirected; `gh` and other shell commands are.
- **Amp:** Amp keeps its threads on Amp's servers, so the PR is written from the diff and git history, not session logs. Only PR commands run in the shell are redirected to Tracetoon.

`tracetoon integrations` prints the same list for your machine, with the
agents it found. Install routes are in [install.md](install.md).
